_source: Shape from https://developers.soundcharts.com/openapi.json, GET /api/v2/song/{uuid}/audience/{platform} with platform tiktok, 200 SongPlotCollectionResponse { related: SongLight, items: AudiencePlot[] { date, plots: Plot[] { identifier, value } }, page: OffsetPage, errors }. TikTok's value is the video count (reference page Get audience). Two days before launch (2026-10-02) and two after. Values are test values. Never seen from the live API.
